description: Five relevant pages first returned tool Cache miss: S001 Belmarket Jan–Feb chronology, S002 Viasna administrative-case roundup, S003 Lawtrend January report PDF, S004 Viasna constitutional-discussion report, and S007 Belmarket Dec–Jan chronology. After the protocol correction, each exact public URL received one ordinary curl GET following a fresh unique access receipt and complete stable canonical/registered-sibling manual ledger review. All five requests failed DNS resolution before HTTP (curl exit 6; HTTP status 000; zero body bytes), so they remain search_only; these are technical failures, not site denials.
